sources.entry: Stability AI - The official website and hub for Stability AI, which offers a variety of AI-driven tools and models, particularly in image generation.

summary.name: Stability AI
summary.one_liner: Stability AI is an enterprise-focused generative AI company offering image, video, 3D and audio models and creative production tools for businesses and creators.
use_cases: storyboarding and color grading for film and video
integrate image and video generation into an app via API
self-host generative models for data control
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Stability AI as an enterprise creative partner offering generative AI models for image, video, 3D/4D and audio content. It lists marketing, gaming and entertainment as target areas, with image generation and editing tools for campaign assets, volumetric 3D and 4D video models for games, and image and video tools for storyboarding and color grading. Delivery options named on the page are self-hosted model deployment (with a license), Brand Studio as a managed creative production platform for enterprise teams, an API for media generation and editing without infrastructure management, and a cloud service. The page describes its models as commercially safe but gives no technical details on specific models or versions.
notable: Self-hosted model deployment for control of data, with a license
Brand Studio managed creative production platform for enterprise teams
Commercially-safe image, video, 3D/4D and audio models
Media generation and editing API requiring no infrastructure management
caveats: Plans are gated behind 'See plans' and 'Get license' links; specific prices are not shown on the page
Positioned for enterprise teams; the page does not describe a free tier
